basics.name: Junteng Liu
basics.summary: First-year PhD candidate at HKUST NLP Group, supervised by Professor Junxian He. Graduated from Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) in June 2024 with a B.Eng. Research focuses on natural language processing and machine learning, with interests in LLM reasoning and reinforcement learning, hallucination in vision-language models, and LLM truthfulness and interpretability.
